TEXT:
I just kinda brought along this card that Gramps 
imposed on me... is this thing legit?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Sorry to keep you waiting, Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Oh... Good to go?
I swiftly hide the point card behind my back.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hmm? Something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, it's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Really? But...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
M-More importantly, are you alright? Aren't you 
tired from not getting enough sleep?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I slept a little on the train, so I'm fine. Also, I 
brought some rock candy, which is supposed to 
work well for drowsiness.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Pfft, what are you, a kid on a field trip?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
*nom nom* You want some too, Kyou-chan? It's so 
sweet and delicious.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll get some from you when I'm actually tired.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Oh really? Just let me know, then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
So, is there anywhere in particular you want to go, 
Manami?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I'm not really proud of it, but I don't know much 
about Kyoto.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I see. Well, good thing we're here again then, huh?
I sure am jealous of your positive thinking.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Do you still remember anything about the places 
we visited during the school trip?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hmm... Well, there's not much point in going to the 
same places again, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Sure there is! There are places I want to see again...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, since it's you, you've probably already made 
your own travel plans, right?

I remember the bent-up, well-used travel brochure 
from our school trip.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Yeah... But since it's just the two of us, it'll be fun no 
matter where we go~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Even if you tell me with that smile...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I got it, how about Kiyomizu Temple? We never 
got to see Kiyomizu’s stage back then.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Sure! That sounds nice.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
You know, I also wanted to see Kiyomizu’s stage.  
We're the same.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah... Also, there's that place called the Waterfall of 
Marriage?

I'm just saying places that are written on the point 
card.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Yup, yup, I want to go, too. Not just those, but 
there's also something called the love fortune teller 
stone at the Jishu Shrine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Oh, that sounds like an interesting place. You sure 
know a lot, just like I thought.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Oh, no no, not at all...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, now we have somewhere to go. Let's head 
out, Manami.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Sure!
I spontaneously held Manami's hand.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm? Oh, uh... You don’t like this?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
N-No... I'm just... very happy that Kyou-chan is doing 
this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: R-Really? You're just exaggerating, ha ha ha.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Your hands are so big. And... warm.

Why does that expression sound a little erotic, 
Manami-san!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
But, aren't you bad with the heat? It's summer 
after all...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: It's your hand, Kyou-chan, so I don't mind.
This time, Manami squeezes my hand tightly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Manami?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ehehe...

She stares at me with a look of pure delight.  That 
alone was enough to show me how happy she was.

But, is this what he meant by "making Manami 
happy?"
...So, I should start getting points, right?
I fiddle with the point card with my open hand...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: What are you doing, Kyou-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: N-Nothing...

I fumble with the card, and in my haste, it slips 
from my hand and falls to the ground.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ah, is that...
Crap! Why now, of all times, did it have to fall NOW!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Grandpa actually DID give it to you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-You knew?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
If you make me happy, I'm supposed to give you 
a stamp... that's what he told me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Speaking of which, if I fill the card up, what 
happens?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Th-That's a secret~~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You won't tell me?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
It's a secret, but you'll figure it out soon.  May I 
have your point card for a second?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Sure.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You sure seem happy.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Well, we haven't held hands since we were kids.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It’s getting more embarrassing because you said 
something weird.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Really? But, don't let go of my hand, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Sure...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
By the way, did you receive anything from my 
Grandpa?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Something from Gramps...
You mean this card?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I knew it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?  Manami, did you know about this?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Yeah. If you do something nice for me, I will stamp 
your card or something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Did you tell you anything else?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No... not really.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I see. Well, can I see your point card?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? Why?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Umm... Well, you held my hand, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, ah...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: So, I'll give you a stamp. Here's one point for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Thank you for your patronage①
She stamps a point onto the point card.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Since it's your first time, should I give you a little 
extra~?

She then proceeds to stamp all the way to the first 
reward square.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Looks like I reached some important spot.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Well, you have enough points, so...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...I-I have to give you some kind of reward, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: R-Reward?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: So, um... can you crouch down for a second?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh...? Like this?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yup, just like that. Hold still...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: *kiss*

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah...
Did... Did she just kiss me on the cheek!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
...Stop staring at me like that, I'm getting 
embarrassed.

Huh? I was so blown away by this I couldn't help 
but stare.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S... Sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Mmm, you don't need to apologize.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Well, shall we go then, Kyou-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah.

Wait... If I fill up the point card all the way to the 
end, then...

I mean, when Manami saw that card she looked 
extremely embarrassed!

I grasped the card tightly while attempting to calm 
my excitement.
